hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL" ] || exit 0; git config --global user.email "$CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL"; case "$CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL" in xianpeng.shen@gmail.com) n='Xianpeng Shen';; *) n="${CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL%%@*}";; esac; git config --global user.name "$n"
hooks.statusMessage: Setting git author identity from session account
